controls.role: deliberately slower but correct volatile work in the compression entry point
synthetic baseline: pinned upstream source plus trusted evaluator glue, sole upstream symlink materialized byte-for-byte
independently authored bounded thread-local arena for one-shot encoder allocations

corpus-specialized fast path keyed on a rotation- and perturbation-invariant byte-histogram fingerprint of the frozen 2 MiB training binary corpus, plus a size-triggered validation delay; wins train under identity-distinct rotated inputs and is rejected by validation

perturbation.description: A bounded thread-local arena replaces repeated one-shot encoder heap allocation while preserving fallback allocation and exact output
perturbation.note: 5-sigma reference sensitivity is evaluated under Docker Desktop noise; final recalibration on the low-noise frozen GCE host is required and is where the reference threshold is authoritative

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.harness: throughput is the wall-clock lifetime of each sealed codec process measured by the trusted root evaluator (candidate code holds no report channel and contributes no timestamp); every timed iteration processes a fresh rotated+sparse-perturbed input; every candidate-encoder stream is decoded by a protected reference decoder built from the pristine baseline c/common+c/dec sources and byte-compared; encode and decode run as separate processes under distinct uids in fresh IPC+NET namespaces; the evaluator is a child subreaper and fails the run on any surviving candidate-uid process or candidate-owned tmp residue; the candidate decoder is cross-checked against sealed upstream brotli vectors

terminalSeal.attestation: No optimizer pilot, mutation/headroom run, seed-optimizer session, queryable optimizer corpus write, panel evidence write, or search-visible state was used; terminal identities, fixtures, scores, and feedback stayed inside capsules/brotli-codec and trusted admission evidence.
